results.content: Myjoyonline.com brings you the front pages of various newspapers across the country.

results.title: Black Stars need time to recover from poor run – GFA
results.content: The men’s senior national team has endured a difficult spell, recording just one victory in their last eight matches across all competitions.

results.title: Ghana U-15s thrash Guam 7-0 to maintain perfect FIFA World Cup Festival run
results.content: Ghana made it three wins from three and have now scored 18 goals in the group stage to remain top of Group W.

results.title: Unbeaten Spintex Knights stuck in Libya as US$29,200 travel bill remains unpaid
results.content: The Accra Basketball League champions are unable to return to Ghana because of unpaid travel and visa expenses, despite securing an unbeaten record in the preliminary stage of the Road to BAL competition.

results.title: Spintex Knights reach Road to BAL Elite 16 unbeaten, set up JCA rematch
results.content: The Ghanaian club will face Ivory Coast's Jeunesse Club d'Abidjan (JCA) in the West Division semifinals, setting up a rematch of last year's encounter.

results.title: Ghana celebrate multiple gains at African Scrabble Championship
results.content: Kyeremateng made history by becoming the first Ghanaian woman to win the Best Female title in the 32-year history of the continental competition, capping an impressive outing for Ghanaian scrabble at the championship, which concluded on Sunday.

results.title: We need to be deliberate – Didi Dramani on developing youth football in Ghana
results.content: Ghana have suffered a series of disappointments in youth football, with the national Under-17 and Under-20 teams struggling to make an impact at continental and global tournaments.

results.title: GPL 2026/27: Berekum Chelsea held to goalless draw by FC Samartex
results.content: Both sides started brightly, with an end-to-end opening period producing few clear-cut chances.

results.title: Margins ID’s superior technology wins Gambia over — Ousman Bah
results.content: Special Adviser to the President of The Gambia on ICT and Digital Economy, Ousman Bah has applauded Margins ID Group for advancing digital identity interoperability, citing Ghana’s system as a model for African-led digitalisation. He said Ghana’s ability to connect identity systems and consolidate data had impressed him, prompting The Gambia to adopt the same technology through a partnership with Margins ID Group.

results.title: ECG schedules maintenance works across six regions from October 26 to 30
results.content: The Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) is undertaking planned and emergency maintenance works across selected communities in six regions from October 26 to October 30, 2026, as part of efforts to improve power supply reliability.

results.title: Gender Minister and GES Director-General to visit Obuasi SHS ahead of reopening
results.content: A high-powered delegation, including the Minister for Gender, Children and Social Protection, Dr Agnes Naa Momo Lartey, and the Director-General of the Ghana Education Service (GES), is expected in Obuasi as authorities prepare to reopen Obuasi Senior High Technical School to continuing students.

results.title: Ebenezer Adjetey Sowah appointed Genkas Energy MD
results.content: Energy expert and a member of the International Society of Petroleum Engineers, Ebenezer Adjetey Sowah, has been appointed Managing Director of Genkas Energy Ltd, effective September 30, 2026. His appointment brings on board his vast experience in petroleum distribution, commercial operations and business management to the leadership of the company, which has interests in oil and gas and renewable energy.

results.title: Kwadaso NCCE educates SHS students on constitutional values
results.content: The Kwadaso Municipal Directorate of the National Commission for Civic Education (NCCE) has engaged students of two senior high schools in the municipality to promote constitutional awareness and responsible citizenship among the youth.

results.title: NCCE engages women’s groups on rule of law and anti-corruption
results.content: The National Commission for Civic Education (NCCE) in the Krachi East Municipality has organised a follow-up civic engagement with women's groups to strengthen public understanding of the rule of law, accountability and the fight against corruption.

results.title: Sandra Amarquaye wins PR Professional Practitioner of the Year at IPR Excellence Awards 2025
results.content: Sandra Amarquaye, Corporate Communications Manager at Karpowership Ghana Company Limited (KGCL), was named PR Professional Practitioner of the Year at the 2025 Institute of Public Relations (IPR) Ghana Excellence Awards.

results.title: NDC cancels constituency election in Amenfi East
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has cancelled its constituency-level election in Amenfi East in the Western Region following challenges during the party’s nationwide internal polls.

results.title: Jerry Ahmed Shaib urges safe contraflow, seeks Metro Mass buses for Weija-Gbawe
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Weija-Gbawe, Jerry Ahmed Shaib, has called on the Ministry of Transport to extend the provision of Metro Mass Transit buses to his constituency to help address persistent transport challenges.

results.title: Gender advocate urges sustained breast cancer education in rural Ghana
results.content: Ghanaian media personality and US-based healthcare professional, Josephine Oppong-Yeboah has urged the Ghana Health Service (GHS) to intensify breast cancer education and outreach programmes, particularly among women in rural communities. She said myths and misconceptions about the disease had contributed to delays in seeking medical care, resulting in preventable deaths.

results.title: Roads Ministry wins PR Organisation of the Year for the second time
results.content: The Ministry of Roads and Highways has won the Public Sector PR Organisation of the Year award for the second consecutive time at the Institute of Public Relations (IPR) Ghana Excellence Awards.

results.title: Government grateful to Benin, Togo, international partners for swift rescue of fishers
results.content: Government has expressed sincere appreciation to the governments of Togo and Benin, and key international maritime partners, for coordinating the rescue of the seven Fishers.

results.title: EC yet to announce Dormaa Central NDC constituency election results
results.content: The Dormaa Central Electoral Commission (EC) in the Bono Region is yet to declare the winners of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) election in the constituency.

results.title: Benjamin Djakumah retains NDC Tema Central chairmanship
results.content: Benjamin Djakumah has retained the Tema Central Constituency chairmanship of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), polling 685 votes in the party’s constituency executive elections.

results.title: Julius Nainoo unseats incumbent NDC constituency chairman in Berekum West
results.content: Delegates of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Berekum West Constituency of the Bono Region have elected Mr Julius Nainoo as party chairman.

results.title: Vice President commends Black Maidens for reaching FIFA U-17 World Cup Last 16
results.content: Vice President Prof. Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang has congratulated Ghana’s Black Maidens on reaching the Round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco after their impressive 2-0 victory over Canada.

results.title: Rapper Nicki Minaj joins Trump onstage at Michigan rally
results.content: Rapper Nicki Minaj said US President Donald Trump has "changed the energy of the country" as she joined him at a Michigan rally to stump for Republicans ahead of the nationwide midterm elections.

results.title: Libya summons US envoy to protest Trump’s remarks
results.content: Libya's foreign ministry summoned the US chargé d'affaires on ​Sunday to protest against rally statements by ‌President Donald Trump it described as "offensive", after he called the North African nation "terror-infested".

results.title: We do not support our own, but we watch horrible Hollywood movies – Yvonne Okoro
results.content: Ghanaian actor and film producer Yvonne Okoro has bemoaned the lack of support for local films

results.title: Ghana loses GH¢209.7m to cyber incidents in nine months – CSA
results.content: Ghana recorded an estimated GH¢209.7 million in losses from reported cybersecurity incidents between January and September 2026, the Director-General of the Cyber Security Authority (CSA), Dr Divine Selasi Agbeti, has disclosed.
